Driver: persisted retry budgets per failure kind
note: Separate retry budgets per failure kind (no tool call, tool unavailable, before execution, verification, git commit), stored with the run state so they survive restarts. dwmt today: turn limit per role, one repair at finish.

title: Driver: stuck and oscillation detection that survives restarts
note: A ledger of block signatures trips after 2 repeats with identical input; it also catches A-B-A oscillation and steps that did no work. Stop with a plain reason instead of looping or waiting overnight.

title: Session supervision: soft, idle and hard timeouts with heartbeat crash detection
note: Soft 20 min, idle 10 min and hard 30 min timeouts per step; a worker heartbeat with a TTL plus a PID check detects a dead session and resumes it. dwmt pain: night stops of 4-6 h, waits nobody saw.

title: Measure and trim tool schemas per role
note: Tool schemas are a large fixed part of every session context. dwmt already sets tools per agent and launch.lean; measure schema tokens per role in the header and trim what a role never uses.

title: Prompt context telemetry: what each session got inline, as excerpt or on demand
note: Every piece put into a prompt is tagged inline/excerpt/on-demand with its size, so prompt growth and re-reads are visible per role in the cost report.

title: Cost spike push: one session over 3x the rolling average
note: A session costing more than 3x the rolling average of the run sessions is flagged. dwmt: push only, never stop (user decision of 2026-10-09 on price alerts), next to the existing over-price push.

title: Script checks across tasks: imports, contract signatures, single-command evidence
note: After each task the host checks that imports resolve, signatures shared between tasks match and patterns stay consistent; every evidence row must be a single command that exited 0, never chained. Fits rules-into-script-checks.
